clues.it: Bruno era nella 8ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e nelle Cucine.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 8th column, in the 1st row and in the Kitchens.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Dario era accanto a delle catene, ma non era accanto a un'armatura.
clues.en: Dario was beside loose chains, but was not beside a suit of armor.

clues.it: Luca era l'unica persona su delle catene, accanto a un'armatura e a ovest di Anna.
clues.en: Luca was the only person on loose chains, beside a suit of armor and west of Anna.

clues.it: Tea era nella 3ª colonna, nella 5ª riga e a ovest di Rosa.
clues.en: Tea was in the 3rd column, in the 5th row and west of Rosa.

clues.it: Marta era nella 7ª colonna e da sola nelle Segrete, ma non era accanto a un calderone.
clues.en: Marta was in the 7th column and alone in the Dungeon, but was not beside a cauldron.

clues.it: Rosa era l'unica persona su della paglia e a ovest di Bruno.
clues.en: Rosa was the only person on a bed of straw and west of Bruno.

clues.it: Anna era accanto a un'armatura, a ovest di Rosa e da sola nella Sala del Trono.
clues.en: Anna was beside a suit of armor, west of Rosa and alone in the Throne Room.

clues.it: Vito era in Biblioteca, ma non era accanto a un tappeto.
clues.en: Vito was in the Library, but was not beside a rug.

general_clues.en: 4 in the west half of the grid.
4 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Bruno lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Bruno's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 8th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Luca lascia una sola casella libera: riga 4ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Luca's own clue leaves a single free square: row 4th, column 2nd.

steps.it: L'indizio di Tea lascia una sola casella libera: riga 5ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Tea's own clue leaves a single free square: row 5th, column 3rd.

steps.it: L'indizio di Rosa lascia una sola casella libera: riga 7ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Rosa's own clue leaves a single free square: row 7th, column 6th.

steps.it: Tea può stare solo nella 3ª colonna: escludendola, a Dario resta una sola casella: riga 3ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Tea can only be in the 3rd column: ruling it out leaves Dario a single square: row 3rd, column 1st.

steps.it: Tea può stare solo nella 3ª colonna: escludendola, a Anna resta una sola casella: riga 8ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Tea can only be in the 3rd column: ruling it out leaves Anna a single square: row 8th, column 4th.

steps.it: Rosa può stare solo nella 7ª riga: escludendola, a Marta resta una sola casella: riga 6ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Rosa can only be in the 7th row: ruling it out leaves Marta a single square: row 6th, column 7th.

steps.it: Anna può stare solo nella 8ª riga: escludendola, a Vito resta una sola casella: riga 9ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Anna can only be in the 8th row: ruling it out leaves Vito a single square: row 9th, column 9th.

steps.it: Nessun altro può stare nella 5ª colonna, e lì a Fabio resta una sola casella libera: la 2ª riga.
steps.en: No one else can be in the 5th column, and it leaves Fabio a single free square there: the 2nd row.
